name: Frozen C-low observation degradation development calibration

selection.combo_gate: all nine conditions admitted and each >= 0.6; only blur2_noise007
selection.review: only one selected candidate per task; no reselection after review

image.position: after original resize/crop/to_tensor at 224x224 [0,1], before both backbone normalizations; once per camera
image.noise: float32 PCG64 local generator; SHA256-derived 128-bit seed; no model seed/strength in key; clip [0,1]
image.crop: floor(224*ratio), offset floor((224-size)/2), tensor bilinear antialias=True; half-pixel K affine; preserve negative fx
image.clean: exact existing processor geometry; no added reencoding

image_admission.sample: first numeric train demo per task; floor linspace(0,n-1,5)
exclude: transformation bug or global severe saturation obscuring manipulation
crop removes previously visible task-critical content from BOTH cameras at any sampled time
target/gripper/manipulation region becomes unrecognizable in BOTH cameras at a previously observable sample
image_admission.manual: all conditions inspected before any scoring; no success-based exclusions; no replacement

failures.infrastructure: preserve attempt, stop; no auto hardware switch
